Definition: from G4130; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:--bundle, company, multitude.
BiblicalUsage: Plethos is a multitude, a great throng. The multitude of them that believed were of one heart and one soul in Acts 4:32, and a multitude of the heavenly host praised God at Bethlehem in Luke 2:13. The multitude came together at Pentecost in Acts 2:6, and Peter says love shall cover the multitude of sins in 1 Peter 4:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a multitude can be one heart or one mob, and the difference is the Spirit in the middle. That is why I hold that unity is not sameness but one heart in Christ.
